notes.title: SEASON 2 IS HERE!
notes.content: [p]WHATS NEW?[/p][p][/p][p]A whole menagerie of animals have joined the roster, just itching to battle.[/p][p][/p][p]Joining this season is Blowfish, Fly, Velvet Worm, Crow, Axolotl, Gecko, Mudskipper, Chicken, Coelacanth, Pig, Koala, Numbat, Dolphin, Cow, Gibbon, Octopus, Cheetah, Piranha, Dimetrodon, and Oviraptor.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44996334/76c653a4f885ece481edd90f3c70d1553219b25b.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]There has been a reshuffling of all the tiers and animal stats. This means all you Shrew/Spider fans will have to say goodbye to your Shrewder. You're all gonna need new strategies![/p][p][/p][p]Another major addition this update is the Battimals Leaderboard. There's no better time to get competitive and climb your way to the top![/p][p][/p][p]All players will start the season with 5000 points. The higher you rank in each match the more points you will earn. But beware ranking below 4th place will cost you points.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44996334/1c0b9d6b99f0e581d812ea58921a0e48d0670973.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]FEATURING[/p][p][/p][p]STARTERS: Blowfish, Frog, Fly, Velvet Worm, Seahorse[/p][p]$5: Crow, Axolotl, Scorpion, Bee, Angler, Sheep, Slug, Cuttlefish[/p][p]$6: Turtle, Gecko, Mudskipper, Toucan, Eel, Bat, Spider[/p][p]$7: Squirrel, Chicken, Coelacanth, Snake, Cat, Rat, Flamingo[/p][p]$8: Pig, Koala, Numbat, Camel, Rabbit, Vulture, Weasel[/p][p]$9: Dolphin, Kangaroo, Echidna, Swordfish, Cow, Dog[/p][p]$10: Fox, Gibbon, Octopus, Tortoise, Ostrich, Walrus[/p][p]$11: Crocodile, Cheetah, Cassowary, Beaver, Piranha[/p][p]$12: Dimetrodon, Oviraptor, Velociraptor, Tyrannosaurus, Stegosaurus[/p][p][/p]

notes.title: SEASON 2 IS COMING
notes.content:
[p]Hello Humans!
[/p][p]It’s confirmed, Season 2 is coming![/p][p][/p][p]20 new animals have entered the roster! Blend up all new Battimals and climb the leaderboard![/p][p][/p][p]That's right, Season 2 also adds the leaderboard, see where you rank against the other humans. Will you be the next Battimals Beastmaster?[/p][p][/p][p]Battimals is available on Steam, Android, and iOS.[/p][p]Crossplay online against your friends and foes or train up offline to prepare for your next battle.[/p]

notes.title: Mobile Update
notes.content:
Hello Humans

Our latest blending experiment is complete!
Combine Steam humans with Android humans and iOS humans to create the ultimate crossplay lobby!

Go online on the go and play your favourite DNA Auto Battler on Steam Deck, Android and iOS Devices.

On sale now!

notes.title: Battimals Easter Event
notes.content:
Hi Humans!

For our first event ever the Easter Bunny is making a special, limited-time appearance in the land of Battimals and they have brought some festive friends.
Can you spot all the new and altered Battimals as well as battle in the new Easter themed arena?

But don't be a slow egg, the Easter event only runs from April 12th to April 27th, get hopping!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44996334/563d200a45c668a9c3c7454fa757562528453fa1.jpg[/img]

Stay tuned for more news soon about this years upcoming updates and new features.
